answer: Audit attestations by re-derivation, not re-endorsement: each epoch a random panel replays a sample of an identity's countersigned transactions from raw inputs, publishing intermediate evidence. Honest verification recomputes opal-clear — identical raw data yields identical results. A sybil ring wields one quill for a thousand stamps, rubber-stamping its own loop to save compute; when its stamps mismatch the panel's recomputation, the lie stands onyx on white. The farmer's only fix is real verification per clone — the honest thousand's full cost.
